name: ModelPicker
label: Model picker
description: A model selector for chat surfaces, with per-model descriptions and an optional effort row.

props.name: models
props.description: The models on offer, in display order.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected model value for controlled use. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected model value for uncontrolled use. Defaults to the first model.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected model's value.

props.name: placeholder
props.description:
Text the trigger shows when no model is selected, and the trigger's
accessible name when no `aria-label` is passed. Defaults to "Choose a model".

props.name: effort
props.description:
Selected effort level for controlled use. Setting this (or `defaultEffort`)
is what makes the effort row appear at all.

props.name: defaultEffort
props.description: Initially selected effort level for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onEffortChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected effort value.

props.name: effortOptions
props.description: The effort levels on offer. Defaults to low, medium and high.
props.defaultExpression:
[
  { label: 'Low', value: 'low' },
  { label: 'Medium', value: 'medium' },
  { label: 'High', value: 'high' },
]

props.name: listLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the model list in the open panel.

props.name: effortLabel
props.description: Heading of the effort row, which is also the accessible name of its radio group.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the trigger the panel opens on. In a composer pinned to the bottom of the screen, use `top`.

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger size, on the row-control scale: `default` is 40px, `compact` 32px, so it lines up with the fields and buttons beside it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the whole control is disabled.
